theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ) (β : Covector (Euclid P) 2), R.Represents C → β ![a, e] = 1 → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, |R.orient x β| ≤ 1) → (∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (c : ℤ), StrictMono φ ∧ c.natAbs = m ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp C a (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C' ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2, C' ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 2) x ![a, e] ∂μHE[2]) ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams (φ j))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams (φ j)) x) ∂R.measure) atTop (𝓝 ((m : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), g x ∂μHE[2]))) → Tendsto (fun s' : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in ball a (3 * s'), ENNReal.ofReal (1 - |R.orient x β|) ∂R.measure) / ENNReal.ofReal (s' ^ 2)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
